archetypes.name: dyn-corpus-policy
archetypes.rationale: Metadata fallback and candidate-scope mismatches can silently change retention and filtering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect run_log_corpus metadata helpers and each caller policy for started_at, ended_at, larch_version, and manifest_candidates. Confirm GC and fluff stay manifest.json-only, rejected analysis keeps updated_at fallback with first-valid stop, and ground-truth strict started_at still continues to run-manifest.json. Check classification numeric versus lexical ordering call sites. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
